objective: Detect negative-shift modulo-convention errors and padding leakage.
observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run the cases on Ascend 950PR, and capture logical and padded output.
pass_condition: Pass iff logical outputs match the floor-mod oracle bitwise (for example -1 maps to width-1/height-1) and padding sentinels remain unchanged.
setup: Run width=17, height=13, pitch=23 with shiftX=-1, shiftY=-1 and with shiftX=-width-2, shiftY=-height-3; pre-fill padding with sentinels; compute floor-mod oracle.
